hostNotes: Accept anything a reasonable person would genuinely chuck in the car for a Victorian coast weekend, any season. Grade to the most specific entry: 'Four Pillars' is Gin, not Booze; unspecified 'alcohol' or 'drinks' is Booze. Generic answers (Clothes, Groceries, Toiletries) count once; don't let a player split them into shirts, pants and socks for extra points. Unqualified 'umbrella' is ambiguous: ask beach or rain. 'Glasses' alone means spectacles; 'wine glasses' is its own entry. Brands, plurals and slang all merge to the canonical. People (Partner, Kids, Dog) are valid answers. Disallow things you buy there (fish and chips, Apostles tickets) and non-items ('good vibes') unless the room votes them in.
